subject: Bulk hoodie discount request
body: We can’t confirm a 20-hoodie order at this time: only 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M are currently in stock, leaving 12 unavailable. The requested bulk discount is not approved yet; we have recommended $46 per hoodie, subject to owner approval. That is below the $58 list price and leaves $24 per hoodie above our $22 unit cost. We do not yet have a confirmed restock date, so we can’t promise when the remaining 12 would be available.
author: Campus Customs Customer Service
